title: [BUG]  Copy paste images doesnt work in WSL and IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 (Ultimate Edition)
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Other:  wsl
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.19 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: Windows 11
- Terminal:  powershell and cmd and IDEA terminal

## Bug Description
Copy paste images doesnt work in WSL and IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 (Ultimate Edition)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Copy image
2. Paste in the terminal

## Expected Behavior
Pasted image, can be used to interact with Claude code.

## Actual Behavior
No effect

## Additional Context
No effect
author: liaolunhui
